What this is, and is not. Real BraTS (MSD Task01), enhancing tumor, held-out patients. Measured across the validation set: enhancement destroys 3.6% of lesions and recovers 8.2% — it helps on net, and its losses are invisible to PSNR. The layer raises about 0.15 flags per slice, of which 20% mark a real vanished lesion: a review prompt, not a diagnosis. This slice is chosen because it shows the effect clearly; roughly 2 slices in 300 do.
